title: Detect impossible perfect DC isolation without mistaking underflow for a zero
statement: For diagonal positive C and a terminal-avoiding path with k internal nodes, W_e=integral_0^P g_e(t)dt>0 and delta=esssup sum_w g_vw/C_v, both -Y_ji and -Y_ij are at least exp(-k*delta*P)*product W_e/[P*product C_v]>0. They vanish together exactly when no such path exists.

requires: Finite reciprocal bounded nonnegative periodic conductances, constant storage and unique stable periodic solution. Static comparison admits general SPD storage; positive-sign/support theorem additionally requires diagonal positive capacities. All terminal offsets constant, full repeated cycle, no internal sources/advection.
provides: For diagonal positive C and a terminal-avoiding path with k internal nodes, W_e=integral_0^P g_e(t)dt>0 and delta=esssup sum_w g_vw/C_v, both -Y_ji and -Y_ij are at least exp(-k*delta*P)*product W_e/[P*product C_v]>0. They vanish together exactly when no such path exists.
assumptions: A path through another clamped terminal is not a transmitting path. General SPD storage cannot inherit compartment positivity. The comparator requires feasible mean contacts; no assertion for every nonconvex actuator budget or every individual current at distinct temperatures. Finite isolation is possible; Float64 zero is not exact zero. At z800 reverse1.5282810767e-351 survives while the saved Float64 coefficient underflows. No universal approximate-router no-go. No acquired measurement, fabricated device, historical priority, efficient algorithm or practical advantage is inferred from these mathematical/model results. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.
costs: Keep full period and cold preparation, parasitic/actuator heat, clock, contacts and resetting. Directionality trades against normalized symmetric loss. At extreme isolation the reported cooling is0.001875 of the matched static star; throughput and isolation targets differ.
contract.units: Y,G have conductance units W/K; C heat capacity; P time. The thermal Dirichlet form is W*K, not electrical power; inverse taken on contrasts.
contract.obstruction: Construct and calibrate compatible contacts and compare matched full-cycle cooling/routing costs; finite mathematical circulation is not a completed practical advantage.

body: Nonnegative variation of constants supplies the path contribution. Assign each next path edge a successive full-period window, so any original phase order can transmit over repeated periods. Retention is at least exp(-k delta P). Reverse the same undirected path to preserve the lower bound. Other clamped terminals absorb the perturbation, so union connectivity alone is insufficient. The theorem excludes finite perfect isolation in this class, not large finite ratios or interference/nonreciprocal primitives.
